entry.title: Drips 1.0.0
entry.summary: **Drips 1.0.0** — a granular texture synthesizer for Akai MPC standalone devices, as an insert effect, built on Émilie Gillet's open-source Beads DSP. - Records the track into a 4–32 s buffer and replays it as up to 30 grains; four recording qualities (Bright Digital, Cold Digital, Sunny Tape, Scorched Cassette), each at its own sample rate. - Delay and beat slicer (SIZE fully clockwise), tempo-synced to the MPC. - Seed latched, gated, or clocked by MIDI notes or the MPC tempo; optional MIDI spl
